usages.explain:
「なお」is a conjunction that connects two sentences. The following sentence adds information to the content of the previous sentence. The additional content does not have to be directly related to the previous sentence. In cases where the added content differs from what was expected based on the information provided, 「なお」can be translated as "however."
It is often used in writing such as footnotes, announcements... rather than in spoken language.

examples.content: この件の説明は以上です。なお、詳細についてプリントをご覧ください。
examples.transcription: このけんのせつめいはいじょうです。なお、しょうさいについてプリントをごらんください。
examples.mean: That's all for this explanation. Please see the printout for details.

examples.content: 今日はこれで終わります。なお、次回の日時は...
examples.transcription: きょうはこれでおわります。なお、じかいのにちじは...
examples.mean: That's all for today. The next date and time is...

examples.content: 作品の提出は今月いっぱいまで。なお、テーマは各自で考えること。
examples.transcription: さくひんのていしゅつはこんげついっぱいまで。なお、テーマはかくじでかんがえること。
examples.mean: Works can be submitted until the end of this month. Please note that each participant should come up with their own theme.

examples.content: このサービスは全部1万円です。なお、子供は5千円だけです。
examples.transcription: このサービスはぜんぶいちまんえんです。なお、こどもはごせんえんだけです。
examples.mean: This service costs 10,000 yen. Please note that children only pay 5,000 yen.

title: なお => still; yet​; furthermore; in addition ~
